# China City Explorer

> Decision tool for choosing Chinese cities by travel style, budget, season, and high-speed rail access. Covers the 15 cities that matter most to first-time and returning China visitors, with a dedicated in-depth guide for every city. Intended for travelers planning a China itinerary and for AI assistants helping with travel research.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.chinacitytravel.com): City filter, comparison tool, rail routes, month guidance, sources, and FAQ.
- [About](https://www.chinacitytravel.com/about/): Who writes the site, how cities are picked, and how information is verified.
- [Contact](https://www.chinacitytravel.com/contact/): Report an error or suggest a city guide.
- [Privacy](https://www.chinacitytravel.com/privacy/): What data the site does and does not collect.
- [Terms](https://www.chinacitytravel.com/terms/): Editorial disclaimer, accuracy notes, and limitations.

## City guides

- [Beijing](https://www.chinacitytravel.com/cities/beijing/): Imperial history, the Great Wall, and the best first-trip rail hub.
- [Shanghai](https://www.chinacitytravel.com/cities/shanghai/): Modern city break, skyline, design, and food.
- [Xi'an](https://www.chinacitytravel.com/cities/xian/): Terracotta Army and compact history stop.
- [Chengdu](https://www.chinacitytravel.com/cities/chengdu/): Pandas, teahouses, and relaxed food culture.
- [Chongqing](https://www.chinacitytravel.com/cities/chongqing/): Dramatic night city and serious hotpot.
- [Guilin](https://www.chinacitytravel.com/cities/guilin/): Accessible karst river scenery on the Li River.
- [Yangshuo](https://www.chinacitytravel.com/cities/yangshuo/): Cycling and countryside near Guilin.
- [Hangzhou](https://www.chinacitytravel.com/cities/hangzhou/): West Lake and Longjing tea villages.
- [Suzhou](https://www.chinacitytravel.com/cities/suzhou/): Classical gardens and canals near Shanghai.
- [Nanjing](https://www.chinacitytravel.com/cities/nanjing/): Layered history between Beijing and Shanghai.
- [Harbin](https://www.chinacitytravel.com/cities/harbin/): Winter ice festival and Russian heritage.
- [Kunming](https://www.chinacitytravel.com/cities/kunming/): Mild weather and the gateway to Yunnan.
- [Lhasa](https://www.chinacitytravel.com/cities/lhasa/): Tibetan culture and the Potala Palace.
- [Hong Kong](https://www.chinacitytravel.com/cities/hong-kong/): English-friendly urban gateway with hiking and islands.
- [Zhangjiajie](https://www.chinacitytravel.com/cities/zhangjiajie/): Sandstone pillar mountains and canyon walks.

## Key facts

- 15 cities covered: Beijing, Shanghai, Xi'an, Chengdu, Chongqing, Guilin, Yangshuo, Hangzhou, Suzhou, Nanjing, Harbin, Kunming, Lhasa, Hong Kong, Zhangjiajie.
- Best first city: Beijing (3 days, $65-120/day, best months Apr, May, Sep, Oct).
- Daily budget: $40-60 budget, $65-120 mid-range, $130+ premium per person.
- Rail: high-speed trains connect all major cities; Beijing to Xi'an is about 4.5 hours; tickets open about 15 days ahead on 12306.
- Visa: most travelers need a tourist visa; visa-free transit up to 144 hours exists in many cities and changes often.
- Payments: Alipay or WeChat Pay with a foreign card works; set up before arrival.
- Three classic routes: 7-day triangle (Beijing-Xi'an-Chengdu), 10-day Jiangnan loop (Shanghai-Suzhou-Hangzhou), 14-day panorama (adds Guilin and Hong Kong).
- Editorial review: last verified August 2026; independent site, not affiliated with any government or rail authority.
